head: ʕlf (< Arab. ʕlf cf. Wehr 866: füttern;)

senses.gloss: füttern; to feed cattle with food made from ḥeṭe, sʕore, etc. you cannot ʕlf a cat or a dog! (p.c. Ilyas 18/08/25)

stems.sensesRaw: füttern; to feed cattle with food made from ḥeṭe, sʕore, etc. you cannot ʕlf a cat or a dog! (p.c. Ilyas 18/08/25)

examples.translation: schon um Mitternacht steht er auf, füttert ihre Pferde
examples.raw: hēš me-fəlgə=d-lalyo ko-qom mʕaləf as=səsyaṯṯe ʻschon um Mitternacht steht er auf, füttert ihre Pferdeʼ; 164; 67/79;

examples.turoyo: Ŭ blalyo mʕalfíwayna u+săwā̀l ŭ maḥәšmíwayna
examples.translation: And at night we would feed cattle and dine in front of a lamp
examples.raw: Ŭ blalyo mʕalfíwayna u+săwā̀l ŭ maḥәšmíwayna ‘And at night we would feed cattle and dine in front of a lamp’ (Dayroyo Aziz)
